reason: The audit is free, there's a DPA, and if it finds less than £1,000 I don't pay, so as a numbers person I'd book the call and let the report make the case. I'd only keep the £99 a month if the first report turns up real money I'm prepared to bill, not just goodwill I already know about.
objection: I already know we do some free work and that's partly how we keep clients. My worry is the report mostly lists stuff I'll choose not to bill, and I've handed client ticket data and contracts to a one-person outfit I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: If the first report's billable findings that I'd actually invoice come in under a few hundred pounds a month, I'd cancel and not take the subscription.
